messages:
elaine-sales: Hey team, quick sync — acme fintech wants a short POC to validate a document search + Q&A flow. They asked for success criteria, timeline, and any security blockers. Can we align today?

matt-eng: +1. Quick Qs: target context length for retrieval-augmented answers? do they need tool-calling for ops (e.g., fetch ledger rows), or just summarization?

joe-customer: They want ~30k of combined docs per query window; occasional tool calls to fetch live balances, but mostly RAG and rerank. SLA: sub-1s for short answers, ~2s acceptable for longer context.

elaine-sales: timeline constraint: 3-week POC with milestone demo at day 14. We need an acceptance checklist by EOD so legal can prep the NDA addendum.

sara-solutions: For success criteria propose: (1) retrieval MRR >= 0.55 on our eval set, (2) end-to-end relevance accuracy >= 82% on 50 gold queries, (3) tool-call correctness >= 95% for balance fetch samples, (4) avg latency <= 1.8s under 10 qps. Thoughts?

matt-eng: That feels reasonable. Model selection notes: recommend 32k context model family for the combined doc window (we can host a quantized variant). For tool calling, design a small explicit interface: call name + JSON payload, validated by stub service. Fallback policy -> if tool timeout > 500ms, return cached summary + "live data delayed" tag.

olivia-ps: Pricing heads-up: 3-week POC estimate w/ Hosted API + modest dedicated capacity for load tests ~ $12k-$18k depending on token throughput and eval volume. If they sign reserved capacity post-POC we can credit part of the POC spend. I'll draft ballpark and attach to the SOW.

security-bot: Security quick flags: they need SOC2 presence, we must confirm no PHI in docs, KMS integration required for Private option, and egress restrictions for EU customers. Also request: run our standard questionnaire (sec-q1-v2) and allow 48-72 hours for security review.

joe-customer: For embeddings/rerank — we'd like semantic search + a learning-to-rank stage. Are your rerankers compatible with dense embeddings + simple pointwise scorer?

matt-eng: Yes. Proposed pipeline: embed documents with our embed model -> candidate retrieval (FAISS) -> rerank model (small cross-encoder or lightweight pairwise scorer). For latency, suggest batch-size 16 for reranker, and precompute dense vectors for static docs. If they need live docs, we can do incremental indexing.

sara-solutions: Eval plan: 100 query set with graded relevance (0/1/2), compute MRR and NDCG@10. Prompt-eval: 30 hallucination-sensitive prompts where we check for extraneous facts. We'll automate checks and attach a notebook. Example rerank invocation sample:

```
# pseudo-call to reranker service
POST /rerank
{
  "query": "what are recent overdraft fees for account x",
  "candidates": ["doc123", "doc456"],
  "top_k": 10
}
```

matt-eng: Dev tasks for POC: (1) provisioning test model instance (32k), (2) set up FAISS index with ~1M vectors, (3) implement tool-call stub + timeout handling, (4) basic observability dashboard for tokens/latency/errors. I can handle 1-3 if I get dev access this afternoon.

elaine-sales: Action items: olivia will send POC quote, sara will share eval template + notebook by EOD, matt will start infra provisioning, security-bot please send the questionnaire link. I'll sync with the customer for kickoff tomorrow 10am PT.

olivia-ps: Sending draft quote now to thread. Attaching SOW template in DM. :thumbsup:

security-bot: Sec questionnaire link: https://redwood.internal/sec/sec-q1-v2 — please fill & return within 72 hrs.

joe-customer: Thanks everyone — we'll prep the docs and the gold query set and have those by tomorrow morning. Looking forward to kickoff.

elaine-sales: Great — closing loop here. If anything changes ping me. :rocket:
